rows.ARS:
Yellow blend Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: JACmem
rows.Origin: Bred by Dr. Keith W. Zary (United States, before 1995).
rows.Bloom: Yellow blend. Mild fragrance. 30 petals. Average diameter 4". Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Patents:
United States - Patent No: PP 9,422 on 9 Jan 1996 VIEW USPTO PATENT
Application No: 08/382,866 on 9 Feb 1995
rows.Notes:
Jackson & Perkins Greenhouse site says Mango has deep apricot-yellow blooms on long, strong stems...
According to the US Patent for this rose, the breeding objective was "to produce a new rose variety having the excellent petal substance, long vase life, and good cut-flower production of MERko combined with the longer stems, dark, glossy foliage, and powdery mildew resistance of JACblem."
